newsitem.title: UK: Vickers workers to start one day strikes.
newsitem.headline: Vickers workers to start one day strikes.

text.p: Engineering workers at a Vickers Defence Systems factory in Leeds, northern England, are to start a series of one day strikes on Friday, their union said.
The workers are embroiled in a dispute with management over pay and conditions, the Amalgamated Engineering and Electrical Union said in a statement on Thursday.
"As far as the company is concerned negotiations are now over and they have taken the first steps towards imposing the changes. This attitude is totally unacceptable," the AEEU said.

The union said it had appealed to the company to return to the negotiating table but it had refused and, after receiving overwhelming endorsement in a ballot, it saw no alternative to strike action. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
